title: Field Sales B2B(salary upto 30k)
description:
**Company Description**
HR TEAM is a professional services organization focused on delivering HR and staffing solutions to businesses across various industries. The company provides end-to-end support, including talent acquisition, workforce management, and employee engagement services. HR TEAM is committed to building long-term partnerships with clients by offering reliable, tailored solutions that support sustainable business growth. Team members work in a collaborative environment with opportunities to learn about diverse sectors and build strong client relationships.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Field Sales B2B role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area with a salary up to 30,000. The Field Sales professional will identify and approach potential business clients, present HR TEAM’s services, and develop proposals aligned with client needs. Daily activities include scheduling and attending client meetings, delivering presentations, negotiating terms, and closing sales. The role also involves maintaining relationships with existing clients, gathering market feedback, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and service delivery. The Field Sales professional will be responsible for meeting sales targets, keeping accurate records of visits and leads, and reporting progress to sales leadership.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Proven ability in B2B field sales, client acquisition, and relationship management.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to understand business needs and match them with suitable HR or service solutions.
* Comfort with traveling within the Kolkata metropolitan area for client visits.
* Basic proficiency in using CRM tools or spreadsheets to track leads and sales activities.
* Self-motivated, target-driven, and able to work independently while collaborating with team members.
* Prior experience in HR services, staffing, or related B2B service industries is an advantage.
* Minimum educational qualification: a completed secondary or higher secondary education; a bachelor’s degree in business or a related field is preferred.
* Ability to communicate in English and local languages commonly used in Kolkata.

title: Business Development Partner - Recruitment Tech (Kolkata)
description:
**About Routed AI**
**Routed AI**
is a next-generation recruiter intelligence and sourcing platform built for modern talent teams and staffing firms. Routed AI competes directly with incumbent recruiter platforms, but wins on deeper talent intelligence, flexible search and meaningfully better price-to-value economics.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
We're expanding across the Eastern India Region and are looking for an experienced, relationship-led sales partner to represent Routed AI in the Eastern India market.
  
  
This is a fully remote role with a fast track to full-time employment - typically within 6 months (or less) once a defined sales threshold is met. Until then, you earn a stipend and best-in-industry commission on every deal you close.
  
  
It is designed for senior professionals who already have access to buyers and want to monetize their relationships with a strong, differentiated product. We're targeting candidates with ~15 years of experience, though we are flexible on this for candidates with highly relevant domain experience in HR tech, recruiter tools sales, or consulting services sold to HR and Talent Acquisition leaders.
  
  
Is This Role For You?
  
  
Before applying, please confirm that you meet all three of the following criteria:
  
  

* 01. You have direct, quota-carrying sales experience in recruitment tools, HR tech, or consulting services sold to HR, TA, or RPO leaders. Candidates from sales support, customer success, or marketing backgrounds should not apply.
* 02. You have sold to the right buyers - Talent Acquisition leaders, HR heads, or RPO leaders - and have closed deals with them, not just supported or serviced them.
* 03. You have existing relationships with TA leaders, HR heads, or RPO leaders in the East India market that you can activate.

NOTE: If you do not meet all three criteria above, this role is unlikely to be a good fit. We appreciate your interest but encourage you to apply when a more relevant opportunity arises.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Identify, engage, and close new customers across the Eastern India region
* Sell to senior HR, Talent Acquisition, and staffing firm decision-makers
* Lead discovery, demos, and commercial discussions end-to-end
* Leverage your existing relationships and network to generate pipeline
* Position Routed AI as a credible, modern alternative to incumbent recruiter platforms. Act as a trusted advisor, not a transactional seller.
* Share market and buyer feedback to help refine positioning and messaging

Who We're Looking For
  
  
We're looking for senior, credible operators with real buyer access, including (but not limited to):
  
  

* Experienced sellers of recruiter tools such as Naukri, LinkedIn Talent Solutions, FoundIt, or similar HR tech / talent intelligence platforms - strongly preferred
* Consultants or consulting firm leaders who have sold professional services or advisory engagements to HR, Talent Acquisition, or RPO leaders - and carry strong relationships with those buyers
* Former senior HR / TA leaders with strong East India industry networks. Please note, this is a SALES ROLE. Your connections matter more than your TA Operations experience.
* Staffing or recruiting firm leaders who understand buyer pain points firsthand
* Fractional sales leaders or GTM advisors in the HR tech ecosystem
* Based in or closely connected to Kolkata for client visits when needed
* Strong consultative, value-based selling skills; comfort with subscription SaaS pricing and enterprise conversations

Compensation & Path to Full-Time
  
  

* Fast track to full-time employment: Typically within 6 months or less once a defined sales threshold is met. During this period, you earn a small monthly stipend plus best-in-industry commission on every deal you close. The stipend-plus-commission structure exists purely to gauge fit, and conversion to full-time (with a full salary) can happen earlier if the threshold is met sooner.
* Best-in-industry commission: On first-year contract value (ACV), plus a monthly stipend during the pre-conversion period. Commissions continue for the full year even after conversion to full-time employment.
* High Performance: High performers may additionally be eligible for ongoing commissions on renewals and expansions, plus equity participation based on performance and long-term engagement.

Territory & Account Ownership
  
  

* Initial focus: Kolkata. Strong performance will unlock expansion across Eastern India.
* Sales partners own the accounts they source and actively manage.
* Strategic account assignments may expand over time based on performance.

Why This Is a Strong Opportunity
  
  

* Clear and credible alternative to legacy recruiter platforms
* Strong price-to-value positioning → easier buyer conversations
* Multiple pricing tiers with natural upsell paths
* Recurring SaaS revenue and long-term partnership potential
* Direct access to a responsive founding team with deep domain expertise
* Real opportunity to grow into a core commercial leadership role as the company scales

title: AVP Premier Relationship Manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Descriptor**
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
  
  
**Wealth and Personal Banking (WPB)**
is our new global business combining Retail Banking and Wealth Management; and Global Private Banking, to become one of the world’s largest global wealth managers with USD1.4 trillion in assets. Across Asia, where wealth pools are growing faster than in any other region, HSBC’s wealth revenues grew 12% in 2019 (year-on-year) to USD5.7 billion. Our dedicated colleagues serve millions of customers worldwide across the entire spectrum of private wealth, ranging from personal banking individuals and families, through to business owners, investors and ultra-high-net-worth individuals. We provide products and services such as bank accounts, credit cards, personal loans and mortgages, as well as asset management, insurance, wealth management and private banking that best suit our customers’ needs.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the WPB team.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The PRM & SPRM role are client facing roles. Playing a integral part of HSBC RBWM flagship offering of ‘’Premier Banking’’ To grow and nurture HSBC Premier relationships (High Networth Individual) segment of the Personal Banking customer base) and achieve business targets as laid down and in accordance with the business plan To facilitate a single point of contact for all Premier customers, anticipate needs and provide required banking/financial advisory services. The jobholder to ensure that high quality customer service is provided to customers in line with Global Premier Service Standards. The identification of opportunities for wealth reviews and delivering wealth solutions as an adviser are amongst the key activities to achieve your goals as complied with local regulatory requirement.
  
  
All this needs to be achieved by keeping the highest standards of integrity towards the bank and clients and the regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities**
**Impact on the Business / Function**

* Maximize profit and achievement of the growth of Premier clients portfolio
* Achieve agreed financial targets by development of existing and new relationships
* Build effective relationships with clients to retain and develop sustainable relationships
* Complete regular reviews with clients to understand their current and long term needs and advise them on the products and services that help them achieve their goals
* Effective use of tools and information to drive client service delivery and performance
* Maintain a minimum standard of qualifying Premier clients within portfolio as stated by Group
* Build a high personal and corporate profile in the community in which you are based. Develop network of Group and External professional contacts with the aim of introducing new business, enhancing technical knowledge and promoting the brand
* Monitor and act on daily sales activity management information and other internal information tools, using them to coach the wider Branch team in support of business goals
* Establish and agree client contact strategies in line with Group operating models
* Fully utilize and input to Client Relationship Management data, ensuring all client information is complete and kept up to date
* Demonstrate excellent understanding of client needs, recommend appropriate products and services, and achieve closure of sales

**Customers / Stakeholders**

* Own the client relationship with HSBC
* Maintain a deep understanding and technical knowledge of relevant products and services available from Group sources and elsewhere in order to provide the best solutions for clients and maximize revenues for Global Wealth and the Group
* Maintain highest standard of excellence in client service across the team and with individual portfolio - Ongoing analysis of client portfolios through marketing of ideas and researching clients
* Monitor client satisfaction data implementing portfolio level improvements
* Work with the broader branch, support and direct teams to ensure achievement of the business performance measures by delivering differentiated products and services to the client

**Leadership & Teamwork**

* To work as part of an integrated branch management team to ensure, standards and are met and operating models delivered
* Proactively support others through direct and indirect actions beyond activities particular to this role
* Collaborate with the wider team to deliver the Branch Performance measures and plan to support the multi-channel client journey
* Establish and maintain strong working relationships with colleagues in the wider businesses and others as appropriate to service client needs

**Operational Effectiveness & Control**

* Ensuring that sales & operations are undertaken in accordance with HSBC Bank and Credit Policy Manual appropriate lending guidelines
* Agree and manage lending facilities within any agreed Approval Authority
* Manage operational risk, by using relevant data to identify risk situations and take any appropriate action to minimize loss
* Adhere to selling process and sales quality requirements
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the Anti Money Laundering and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional Offices / Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated
* Requesting additional training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of Politically Exposed People acceptance, prohibition, guidelines in order to ensure that is fully compliant
* Understand the relatively high reputational risk that arises from any perceived weaknesses in controls in respect of substantial cash deposits or withdrawals activity, wire transfer, monetary instruments and pouch and mail
* To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers
* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures
* To be aware of AML risk posed by pouch and mail, Monetary instruments, cash services and wire transfer services and should undergo the mandatory training for the same
* Necessary remediation steps needs to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non-adherence to the policy laid down
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile , else raise it to line manager for further clarification
* The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner
* Ensure adequate due diligence is undertaken by the Individual/team to ensure that the nature of the various transactions of wire transfer, cash services, monetary instruments are in sync with customer profile

**Major Challenges**
The bank seeks to grow business through an efficient operation and the pursuit of providing clients with globally consistent experiences, excellent service, cross selling products and services appropriate to client needs in order to enhance that value. In the face of fierce competition in this segment the bank is seeking to grow the significance of this group in their contribution to our business.
  
  
The Premier segment typically comprises clients with Total Relationship Balances of 25lakhs or more.
  
  
We should also recognize our responsibility to the community in which we operate and improve the bank’s profile within those communities building economic value for the bank and its shareholders.
  
  
The range of competitors and products has established an increased financial awareness in clients, creating demand for increased experience and skill at PRM level.
  
  
**A Premier Relationship Manager Requires The Following Key Attributes**

* Excellent sales and people management skills
* Client driven with a strong focus on quality of service
* Strong interpersonal communication skills
* A strong sense of ownership, responsibility and accountability
* An excellent understanding of financial planning, wealth management and understanding client need

The jobholder forms an integral part of the wider HSBC management team. As part of this wider team the jobholder is expected to identify opportunities in their day to day activities that directly or indirectly contribute to the success of colleagues with differing responsibilities, particularly in other areas of HSBC such as Commercial and Private Bank.
  
  
**Role Context**
The jobholder will own and manage a portfolio of clients with Total Relationship balance of 25 lacs or more
  
  
**The Jobholder Has Prime Responsibility For**

* Maximizing growth in their portfolio and achieving the plan/metrics
* Leading Premier activities to ensure opportunities are identified and client needs are met effectively, maximizing all available resources.
* Compliance with the relevant Group standards including regulatory organization as applied to the implementation of the strategy in their country

Jobholder will hold Lending Approval authorities appropriate to their role.
  
  
The job holder operates within the approved operating and strategic plan process to develop the business.
  
  
**Management of Risk**

* Adheres to processes and controls to identify and mitigate risks and ensures timely escalation of control issues and reputation risks.

**Observation of Internal Controls**

* Maintains HSBC internal control standards and addresses audit points and/or any issues raised by regulators in a timely manner.

**Role Dimensions**

* Portfolio Size of Total Relationship Value of 25 lakhs or more per customer
* Portfolio Size of Premier clients or number of relationships as dictated by market requirements
* Growth in Income, balances, clients volumes, number of clients, etc..

**Qualifications - External**
**Knowledge & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree with relevant experience
* Minimum of 5-8 years of Relationship management work experience with high net worth clients.
* Evidence of strong sales results in insurance and investment products
* Relationship management experience with high net worth clients
* Strong technical skills in wealth management
* Strong communication, client focus and influencing skills
* Strong sales orientation, networking and portfolio management skills
* Sound knowledge of financial services products and services and the client relationship management system
* Understanding of business banking client segment and products and services
* Local regulatory & license requirements - job holder should possess valid licenses with accreditation on wealth management and qualification as required by country
* Clear view on how to work with Compliance, Credit & Risk and Internal Control to ensure a balanced risk operating environment
* Able to communicate well in English and local languages

**Accreditations**

* IRDA (Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority) and AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds) certifications are mandatory

**Leadership Capabilities**

* Have an understanding of the immediate regional Global Wealth strategy and the ability to plan own activities accordingly
* Be ambitious about providing the highest standards of delivery to colleagues and clients
* Show ability to set stretch goals for self and the ability to deliver these with courage and tenacity
* Be authentic and show ability to engage with colleagues and clients to deliver at pace
* Make considered decisions that protect HSBC & Global Wealth values, reputation and businesses

**Technical Capabilities**
**Global Wealth Management - Relationship Manager Technical Capabilities**
**Client Skills**

* Client focus
* Sales orientation
* Portfolio management
* Communicating & influencing

**Business Acumen**

* Marketplace knowledge
* Business understanding

**Solutions**

* Premier products and services
* HSBC services and propositions

**Processes**

* Risk and compliance
* Business processes
* Tools and systems

**Pro-tip :**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  

* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Strategic Account Manager - Large Conglomerates
description:
**Strategic Account Manager - Conglomerates**
**The Mission**
As our Account Director, you won't just be managing account—you’ll be the architect of digital evolution for some of India's most influential industrial giants. We are looking for a visionary who can talk tech over tea, pitch automation while sipping espresso, and turn complex industrial challenges into a five-star digital experience.
  
  
If you believe the future of industry is smart, sustainable, and slightly spicy, we’ve saved you a seat at the table. We are specifically looking for the leader who doesn't wait for things to happen; if there's a traffic jam, you're the one getting out of the vehicle to clear the way forward.

* Ecosystem & GTM Orchestration: Drive a "whole ecosystem" strategy by collaborating with various Go-To-Market channels, including System Integrators, Distributors, and Strategic Alliances, to fulfill complex customer requirements.
* Strategic Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of high-value strategic accounts, building deep, trust-based partnerships with key stakeholders.
* Business Architecture: Co-create impactful digital transformation strategies by deeply understanding the customer’s business models, operational challenges, and long-term goals.
* Value Proposition Execution: Collaborate with internal teams—Solution Architects, Portfolio Managers, and Marketing—to deliver tailored propositions that address industry-specific needs like energy efficiency and production agility.
* Innovation Leadership: Introduce customers to cutting-edge technologies, including AI, IoT, and digital enterprise solutions, while translating technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes.
* Performance Tracking: Achieve Order Intake (OI), revenue, and customer satisfaction targets while maintaining accurate pipeline visibility using CRM tools like SieSales or SFDC.

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field; an MBA is an added advantage, however not mandatory.
* Experience: 5+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally within the Automation, Digital Solutions, or large-scale Industrial sectors.
* Strategic Mindset: Proven ability to manage complex sales cycles and deliver consistent business growth through both technical and commercial innovation.
* Ecosystem Expertise: A strong understanding of how to leverage external partners (SIs/Distributors) to provide a comprehensive solution to the end-customer.

**Why Join Us?**
You will have the autonomy to navigate some of the most significant industrial portfolios in the country while being backed by a global leader in digital innovation. We offer a seat at the table where your strategies will directly influence the future of smart infrastructure in India. #SL

title: Senior Account Manager Conglomorate
description:
**Description**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the pioneer in Cloud Computing and recognized among the world’s largest and most innovative global enterprises. Our breadth of cloud services are used by hundreds of thousands of developers and businesses around the world. Indian Enterprises are going through a paradigm shift in how they innovate and reinvent themselves in the digital-first world. Adoption of cloud has become a key enabler of this journey.
  
  
AWS has helped a number of companies, across diverse industries, achieve resiliency, scale, agility and drive better customer engagement. We are looking for a seasoned leader with business background, technical depth, and excellent communication skills capable of mentoring an experienced team of sales leaders who are helping some of our large Indian Conglomerates continue to innovate, transform and grow their business, leveraging AWS.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
This leader will bring deep and strong C-level relationships with influencers (in business and IT / CIO functions across enterprise levels) to help further establish Amazon as the leader in enterprise cloud computing.
  
  
Towards this goal, s/he will be leading a pan-India team of sellers and partner closely with AWS - Solution Architect teams, Partner teams, Marketing, Enterprise support and Proserv teams to drive tangible business outcomes for our large Conglomerate customers.
  
  
We are looking for a self-starter who is prepared to own, define, develop and execute a geographic plan to consistently deliver on quarterly revenue targets/ quota.
  
  
This leader would report into the Head of Conglomerates, AWS India.
  
  
**About The Team**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of sales operations or equivalent experience
* 3+ years of exceeding quota and key performance metrics experience
* Experience building and cultivating relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Experience in negotiation and selling
* Experience managing and developing high performance teams
* Experience engaging, verbally and in writing, with internal and external stakeholders to convey complex ideas in a clear, concise manner
* Experience in technology related sales, business development or equivalent
* 11+ years of driving growth through and with cross-functional teams including inside sales, technical, marketing, segmentation, legal (contracts) experience
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in technical support and experience in managing and troublshooting network
* Experience working with, presenting to, and negotiating with C-level executives, IT, lines of business, procurement, finance, legal and internal stakeholders for sizeable commercial/enterprise deals
* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related technical field
* Are enrolled in or have completed a full-time MBA program in mathematics, engineering, statistics, computer science or a related field
* Experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service, or experience in managing and troublshooting network and experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* Experience working independently with minimal supervision, or 2+ years of Amazon experience
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Experience influencing at all levels within an organization, particularly at the executive level

title: Senior Sales Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
At Zendesk, we’re revolutionizing what’s possible in Customer Experience (CX) and Employee Services (ES). Our rapid innovation and Agentic AI leadership have earned the trust of thousands of forward-thinking businesses.
  
  
We are seeking aSenior Sales Engineer to sit at the intersection of enterprise software strategy, hands-on systems architecture, and advanced AI automation. This is not a traditional generalist presales role. This is a role built for highly technical builders who are deeply curious about how autonomous agents, security, analytics, and deep integrations fundamentally transform how enterprise work gets done. You will own the technical strategy for our global customer engagements, acting as a strategic advisor to both the C-suite and engineering leadership.
  
  
Why This Role? Why Now?
  
  

* Drive the AI Revolution: Step into an elite presales environment where you will directly architect the deployment of modern Agentic AI workflows and Large Language Models (LLMs) for top global enterprises.
* Strategic Scope: Evolve your career by expanding your enterprise influence by presenting technical value narratives directly to economic buyers and C-level stakeholders.
* Innovative Culture: Work within an ecosystem designed to optimize human potential through advanced digital tools, where continuous learning, curiosity, and experimentation are hardwired into our daily performance.

Who We're Looking For
  
  
We are looking for a highly technical Individual Contributor who operates with considerable judgment and initiative. You understand the complex operational and financial implications of architecture choices and can confidently design customized enterprise-grade solutions. You have a passion for clean system configurations, combined with a sharp commercial mindset that links technical capabilities directly to business metrics, ROI, and organizational transformation.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Architect Agentic AI & Integration Workflows: Design, build, and operationalize advanced, agentic AI-driven customer workflows leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), deep prompt engineering, and modern automation frameworks.
* Lead Technical Architecture Discovery: Conduct rigorous, deep-dive technical discovery and AI readiness assessments. Translate complex system requirements into scalable pilots and proofs-of-concept (POCs) and enterprise-grade pilots that demonstrate clear business value.
* Build Scalable Accelerators: Proactively develop production-ready, reusable technical accelerators, middleware templates, and open-source-aligned API components that allow regional teams and Systems Integrators (SIs) to deploy Zendesk solutions at scale.
* Own the Technical Sales Lifecycle: Serve as the absolute technical authority from qualification through execution. Architect secure, scalable topologies leveraging Zendesk APIs, webhook frameworks, and leading cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Bridge Product & Field Strategy: Partner directly with Product Management and Engineering to provide real-world, technical feedback from the field, identifying product gaps and shaping the future roadmap of Zendesk's core AI and platform ecosystem.

**What You Bring To The Role (Basic Qualifications)**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in a related highly quantitative technical discipline is required.
* Experience: 6+ years of hands-on experience in technical presales, solution engineering, or a system architect/developer role within enterprise SaaS or complex software environments.
* Technical Fluency: Deep expertise with modern web and scripting technologies (e.g., Python, Node.js, JavaScript), REST/SOAP APIs, middleware frameworks, and cloud ecosystem architectures.
* AI/ML Expertise: Strong foundational knowledge of AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and autonomous agent deployment.
* Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of enterprise infrastructure, contact center tech stacks (CCaaS, telephony, workforce management), or modern IT Service Management (ITSM) systems.
* Travel Commitment: Ability and willingness to travel between 30% and 50% annually to lead critical, high-touch on-site customer architecture sessions and strategic regional briefings.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A Master’s degree or professional technical cloud/AI certifications.
* Active engagement in the technical or developer community (e.g., open-source contributions, technical blogging, or community mentorship).
* Proven track record of designing reusable implementation guides, integration playbooks, or localization toolkits for global delivery partners and systems integrators.
* Experience flattening complex technical narratives into high-impact presentations tailored for executive, economic buyers and C-level stakeholders.

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.
  
  
**The Intelligent Heart Of Customer Experience**
Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.
  
  
Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.

title: Manager - CRM and sales transformation
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Consulting - Manager - CRM and Sales Transformation**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Manager - CRM and Sales Transformation will drive CRM and sales transformation initiatives within the Customer practice, combining CRM strategy, sales effectiveness, commercial operating model design, and delivery excellence. The role will support clients in improving lead-to-cash processes, pipeline discipline, customer engagement, sales productivity, and adoption of CRM-enabled workflows. You will work with senior stakeholders to assess sales and CRM maturity, shape transformation roadmaps, and implement practical solutions that improve conversion, forecasting, sales governance, and revenue realization.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Business Development & Market Leadership

+ Support CRM and sales transformation pipeline development across advisory and implementation opportunities, contributing to revenue growth and client expansion.
+ Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, solution design workshops, CRM demos, and executive-level presentations to support deal progression.
+ Support GTM strategies for CRM modernization, sales effectiveness, customer data improvement, and commercial operating model transformation.
+ Design practical CRM and sales transformation offerings aligned with client priorities, including sales process standardization, pipeline governance, account planning, and digital selling enablement.
+ Contribute to thought leadership, points of view, and client conversations on CRM adoption, sales productivity, commercial excellence, and AI-enabled sales insights.
+ Stay abreast of evolving sales models, customer engagement trends, CRM capabilities, and digital selling practices that may affect client growth strategies.

* Client Engagement & Delivery

+ Lead CRM and sales transformation workstreams from current-state assessment through solution design, implementation planning, adoption, and value tracking.
+ Assess sales processes, CRM usage, data quality, coverage models, lead management, opportunity management, account planning, forecasting, and performance governance to identify improvement opportunities.
+ Design CRM-enabled operating models, sales process frameworks, governance mechanisms, role definitions, adoption plans, and performance dashboards.
+ Drive standardization and enablement initiatives across lead management, opportunity management, pipeline reviews, territory planning, account management, forecasting, and customer engagement workflows.
+ Partner with sales, marketing, customer service, technology, and data teams to translate commercial priorities into business requirements, process maps, user stories, and implementation roadmaps.
+ Support adoption of CRM workflows, sales analytics, automation, and AI-enabled insights to improve selling discipline, customer engagement, and productivity.
+ Develop business cases and financial models to quantify revenue uplift, productivity gains, forecast accuracy improvement, conversion improvement, and cost-to-sell reduction.
+ Ensure delivery excellence across assigned workstreams, including scope, timeline, budget, stakeholder alignment, dependencies, risks, and executive reporting.

* Technology & Innovation

+ Enable teams to leverage CRM platforms, sales enablement tools, marketing automation, customer data platforms, workflow automation, analytics, and AI-enabled insights.
+ Stay ahead of technology trends shaping CRM and sales transformation, including generative AI for sales, next-best-action, lead scoring, sales forecasting, and intelligent account planning.
+ Identify opportunities to develop reusable CRM assessment tools, sales process design assets, adoption playbooks, and performance dashboard templates.

* Leadership & People Development


+ Manage project teams or workstreams and ensure high-quality delivery across CRM and sales transformation engagements.
+ Mentor consultants and analysts on CRM transformation methods, sales process design, requirements structuring, delivery governance, and stakeholder engagement.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Demonstrate knowledge of CRM and sales transformation capabilities, including operating model design, adoption strategy, sales governance, incentive effectiveness, territory planning, and pipeline optimization.
* Have experience leveraging digital selling and AI-driven sales capabilities, including lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, customer 360 insights, and advanced sales analytics.
* Have experience with leading CRM platforms and ecosystems, including Salesforce Sales Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales, HubSpot, Oracle CX, SAP Sales Cloud, and similar technologies.

**What We Look For**

* 8+ years of experience in CRM transformation, sales transformation, commercial excellence, revenue growth strategy, sales operations, or customer engagement transformation.
* Consulting experience is desired.
* Proven experience supporting or leading CRM-enabled sales transformation programs, CRM adoption initiatives, or sales performance improvement initiatives.
* Strong understanding of lead management, opportunity management, pipeline governance, account planning, forecasting, territory planning, customer data, and sales performance metrics.
* Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, sales analytics, workflow automation, sales enablement tools, or sales process redesign.
* Strong stakeholder management, business communication, structured problem-solving, and project delivery skills.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
Job Description \| Regional Sales Manager — Power (State Head, Trade)
   

  

 \*\*Regional Sales Manager — Power\*\*
   

  

 \_Sturlite Voltedge Private Limited \| State Head — Trade Channel \| Pan\-India\_
   

  

 \_\_\*\*Function\*\*
   

  

 Sales \& Business Development — Power Division (Wires, Cables \& Switchgear)
   

  

 \_\_\*\*Level\*\*
   

  

 Senior Management (Regional Sales Manager / State Head)
   

  

 \_\_\*\*Openings\*\*
   

  

 Multiple positions — one per state / territory (see markets table below)
   

  

 \_\_\*\*Location\*\*
   

  

 State capital or key commercial hub within the assigned territory
   

  

 \_\_\*\*Reports To\*\*
   

  

 Joint Business Head — Power (Mr. Suresh Jain \& Mr. Sandeep Kantilal)
   

  

 \_\_\*\*Team Size\*\*
   

  

 Leads 4–6 ASMs and 18–28 TSIs across the assigned state
   

  

 \_\_\*\*Travel\*\*
   

  

 12–15 days per month across the state or cluster
   

  

 \_\_
   

  

 \*\*About Sturlite Electric\*\*
   

  

 Founded in 2009 by Mr. Sanjay Jain and Mr. Mukesh Jain, Sturlite Electric is a Bengaluru\-based electrical products company that has compounded at \~35% CAGR for the better part of a decade — reaching ₹700 Cr ARR through a 16,000\+ partner channel spanning 25 states. The lighting portfolio that built the business is TUV Rheinland\-certified and has earned Sturlite a rare distinction in the Indian electrical trade: a challenger brand that distributors and retailers respect on merit, not on price.
   

  

 Seventeen Years Into The Business, The Founders Are Taking The Brand Into Two New Categories — Committing Greenfield Manufacturing Capital At Kadi, Mehsana (Gujarat) To Do It The Right Way
   

  

 \_
   

  

* \_Wires \& Cables — house wires (Flamecore\+ FR\-LF, Greencore\+ HR\-FR\-LF, Ultracore\+ HR\-FR\-LSH\-LF) on Class 5 fine\-flexible conductor and 99\.97% electrolytic\-grade copper, manufactured to IS 694 and IS 17048\. Flexible/control cables, submersible cables, and communication cables (CAT 6, telephone, speaker). RoHS\-clean by design, with serialised anti\-counterfeit architecture. \_
* \_Switchgear \& MCBs — miniature circuit breakers, RCCBs, isolators, distribution boards, and the wider modular protection range for residential, commercial, and light industrial use. ISI\-marked and engineered to integrate naturally with the wires range at the panel and the dealer counter. Over the next three to four years, Sturlite will grow into a multi\-category electrical group of ₹2,000 Cr\+ — built on four legs: lighting, wires \& cables, switchgear \& MCBs, and wiring devices. \*\*The team being built for the Power Division defines this next chapter. The Power Division is being built once. The people who build it own how it gets built.\*\* \*\*The Opportunity\*\*


**Role**
 This is not a maintenance role in an established business. It is a state P\&L leadership role in a brand\-new category. The right candidate will:
   

  

 \_
   

  

* \_Enter a market where Sturlite Power has zero legacy baggage — no old pricing issues, no burned relationships, no stuck stock. \_
* \_Leverage Sturlite's existing lighting dealer network (16,000\+ partners) as a ready entry point for distributor and retailer conversations. \_
* \_Represent a product with genuine quality credentials — ISI\-marked, Class 5 conductor, copper\-pure, competitively positioned against Polycab, Finolex, KEI, and RR Kabel. \_
* \_Have the backing of an established, growth\-oriented company investing seriously in the category — trade schemes, BTL support, the Sumangal electrician loyalty programme, and Ranveer Singh as brand ambassador. \_
* \_Build a team of ASMs and TSIs over time — this role is a state P\&L owner from Day 1, growing into a multi\-state mandate in Phase 2\.


 \*\*Key Responsibilities\*\*
   

  

 \*\*1\\. Revenue \& P\&L Ownership\*\*
   

  

 \_
   

  

* \_Achieve revenue plan (monthly, quarterly, annual) for the full portfolio — house wire, flexible, submersible, communication cables, and switchgear / MCBs. \_
* \_Maintain portfolio mix discipline across the full range, tracking the Y1 baseline to Y3 steady\-state trajectory. \_
* \_Manage credit and collections at state level; keep DSO within company norms (≤ 45 days). \_
* \_Conduct monthly business review with Joint BH — performance, market intel, and escalations. \*\*2\\. Team Leadership — ASMs \& TSIs\*\* \_
* \_Lead a team of 4–6 ASMs and 18–28 TSIs across the state — hire, train, develop, and retain. \_
* \_Assign zone territories, set targets, build beat plans; conduct joint market visits and weekly reviews. \_
* \_Coach ASMs on distributor management, SKU\-mix discipline, and Sturlite's competitive positioning. \_
* \_Build a team culture of ownership, field discipline, and commercial accountability from Day 1\. \*\*3\\. Distributor Strategy \& Channel Health\*\* \_
* \_Own distributor strategy for the state — appointment, ROI management, performance reviews, conflict resolution. \_
* \_Map the state's electrical wholesale and distribution landscape; identify and prioritise the right distributor profile for Sturlite Power. \_
* \_Ensure distributors are adequately stocked, trained on the product, and motivated to push Sturlite actively. \_
* \_Activate key electrical wholesale hubs — establish Sturlite Power as a visible, credible option at the counter within the first 90 days. \*\*4\\. Sumangal Electrician Programme — State Execution\*\* \_
* \_Execute the centrally\-designed Sumangal electrician loyalty programme at state level; BU Head owns design, RSM owns execution. \_
* \_Drive electrician enrolments, monthly nukkad meets, product demos, and coupon\-to\-order conversion across all zones. \_
* \_Monitor Sumangal ordering velocity — ≥ 25% of enrolled electricians ordering quarterly. \*\*5\\. Strategic Kitty Deployment\*\* \_
* \_Deploy the RSM discretionary strategic kitty — for early\-bird distributor offers, month\-end off\-take pushes, and small schemes to distributors that drive secondary off\-take to retailers. \_
* \_RSM is the sole authority for kitty deployment; ASM and below have no scheme authority. \_
* \_Kitty quantum is set annually by the BU Head; RSM is accountable for ROI (target: ≥ ₹15 of incremental billing per ₹1 deployed). \*\*6\\. Demand Planning \& Supply Coordination\*\* \_
* \_State\-level demand planning and forecasting; coordinate with manufacturing for monthly supply allocation. \_
* \_Drive new SKU launches and sub\-brand traction — sampling, dealer education, electrician demos. \_
* \_Represent Sturlite at state trade bodies, BIS audits, and electrical contractor associations. \*\*7\\. Brand Visibility \& Market Intelligence\*\* \_
* \_Drive in\-shop visibility — ensure branding materials, product samples, price lists, and display boards are in place at key retail counters. \_
* \_Track competitor activity closely — Polycab, Finolex, KEI, RR Kabel, Havells — monitor pricing, schemes, new launches, and distributor moves in the state. \_
* \_Provide monthly market intelligence reports to the Joint BH team; flag opportunities and threats in real time. \*\*Key Performance Indicators\*\* \_\_\*\*KPI\*\*
* T\*\* Revenue achievement


 \_\_ ≥ 95% of annual plan; ≥ 90% in any quarter
   

  

 \_\_ Monthly
   

  

 \_\_ Portfolio mix discipline
   

  

 \_\_ Per Y1 baseline → Y3 SS trajectory; ±5pp quarterly band
   

  

 \_\_ Quarterly
   

  

 \_\_ Distributor health (ROI score)
   

  

 \_\_ ≥ 18% ROI for ≥ 80% of distributors
   

  

 \_\_ Quarterly
   

  

 \_\_ Beat coverage
   

  

 \_\_ 100% beat mapped by M6; ≥ 90% visit compliance
   

  

 \_\_ Monthly
   

  

 \_\_ Active billing %
   

  

 \_\_ 30% of beat by M12 (Y1\); 50% by Y3 SS
   

  

 \_\_ Monthly
   

  

 \_\_ ASM team retention
   

  

 \_\_ ≥ 90% Y1; ≥ 95% Y2 onwards
   

  

 \_\_ Annual
   

  

 \_\_ Strategic kitty ROI
   

  

 \_\_ ≥ ₹15 of incremental billing per ₹1 deployed
   

  

 \_\_ Monthly
   

  

 \_\_ DSO
   

  

 \_\_ ≤ 45 days for distributors
   

  

 \_\_ Monthly
   

  

 \_\_ Sumangal — enrolment
   

  

 \_\_ Per state EPP target (2–3× beat annually)
   

  

 \_\_ Monthly
   

  

 \_\_ Sumangal — ordering velocity
   

  

 \_\_ ≥ 25% of enrolled electricians ordering quarterly
   

  

 \_\_ Quarterly
   

  

 \_\_ Contractor pull\-through
   

  

 \_\_ ≥ 15% of state billing from contractor\-driven retailer orders
   

  

 \_\_ Monthly
   

  

 \_\_
   

  

 \*\*Qualifications \& Experience\*\*
   

  

 \*\*Essential\*\*
   

  

 \_
   

  

* \_12–18 years in wires / cables / switchgear / electricals sales. \_
* \_Minimum 5 years as ASM or equivalent zone\-lead role at an established player. \_
* \_Demonstrable track record of running a ₹50\+ Cr Trade P\&L. \_
* \_Multi\-region or multi\-state exposure preferred. \_
* \_Team management of 15\+ people including ASMs. \_
* \_Prior experience at Polycab, Finolex, KEI, RR Kabel, Havells, V\-Guard, or equivalent W\&C brand. \_
* \_Comfort with SFA / mobile\-based tools and data\-driven decisions. \_
* \_Graduate (engineering preferred); MBA a plus but not mandatory. \*\* \*\* \*\*Preferred\*\* \_
* \_Experience with tiered distributor structures and electrician loyalty programmes. \_
* \_Deep knowledge of the state's electrical wholesale landscape — key wholesale hubs, top distributor names. \_
* \_Resident in (or willing to relocate to) state HQ city. \_
* \_Regional language fluency mandatory.


 \*\*Ideal Candidate Profile\*\*
   

  

 \_
   

  

* \_\*\*Builder, not Maintainer:\*\* Has launched a zone, state, or category from zero before and prefers that over inheriting a settled book. \_
* \_\*\*Channel\-Credible:\*\* Can pick up the phone and get a meeting with the top 20 distributors in the territory. Reputation in the trade matters more than CV polish. \_
* \_\*\*Commercially Literate:\*\* Reads scheme ROI, mix margin, and working capital impact natively. Will not over\-spend a scheme to chase a billing number. \_
* \_\*\*Phase\-1 Mindset:\*\* Comfortable with months 1–4 being slower than plan, and disciplined enough to keep building through that period without panic\-discounting. \_
* \_\*\*Direct Communicator:\*\* Short messages, clear numbers, no theatre. Will tell the JBH when something is broken instead of dressing it up. \_
* \_\*\*Self\-Starter:\*\* Sets their own daily agenda, plans their own beat, and does not wait to be told where to go or what to do.


 \*\*What Sturlite Offers\*\*
   

  

 \_
   

  

* \_Founding\-team membership in an IPO\-track manufacturing venture with BIS\-certified domestic plant at Kadi, Mehsana (Gujarat). \_
* \_A genuinely differentiated product portfolio — Class 5 stranded conductor, three house\-wire tiers, full flexible / submersible / communication cable range, plus switchgear \& MCBs. \_
* \_Ranveer Singh as brand ambassador — meaningful pull at the dealer counter. \_
* \_Direct working access to founders. Decisions in days, not quarters. \_
* \_Full ownership of state (or state\-cluster) P\&L — empowerment with accountability, no matrix layers diluting the role. \_
* \_Successful Phase 1 RSMs are first in line for multi\-state roles as Sturlite enters Phase 2 and beyond. \_
* \_Clear career path to National / Zone Business Head as the state business scales — Sturlite grows its leaders from within.

 growth.

 Platform. This includes conducting product demos, addressing lead queries, ensuring

**Qualifications \& Experience**

title: Operations Lead
description:
Position Purpose
 
 The Operations \& Strategy Lead acts as the chief liaison and operational bridge between the Promoter/Managing Director and the factory floor. Stationed permanently at the plant, this person ensures strict execution of management directives, monitors operational and financial KPIs across production and utilities, tracks customer dispatches and receivables, and coordinates business development initiatives.
 



 This is a high\-ownership operational role for a commercially sharp operator who wants to learn how to run a mid\-market industrial manufacturing enterprise.
 



  





**Location:** 
 On\-site daily at Manufacturing Facility, Hooghly, West Bengal
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Managing Director / Promoter
 



**Working Relationship:** 
 Works alongside the Plant Head, QA/QC Lead, and Commercial Accounts Team
 



**Experience Level:** 
 3–6 years post\-MBA (or equivalent operational experience)
 



  




 Key Responsibilities1\. Promoter Cockpit \& Daily Plant Governance
 * Review and validate the Daily Production Report (DPR) generated by the plant team
* Independently flag operational anomalies, line stoppages, unapproved material consumption, or safety/maintenance lapses directly to the Managing Director.
* Track the daily utility consumption and performance metrics of the HVAC systems, chillers, and newly commissioned heat pump systems against baseline power targets.
* Ensure standard operating procedures (SOPs), company policies, and management directives are rigorously implemented across the shop\-floor staff.
* Prepare monthly executive MIS presentations detailing gross margins, direct cost breakdowns, debtor aging, and capacity utilisation trends for promoter review.



  




 2\. Commercial Coordination, Dispatches \& Working Capital
 * Act as the daily bridge between customer orders and plant production schedules, ensuring priority batches for key institutional accounts are produced and packaged on schedule.
* Track raw material inventory levels and reconcile daily consumption against purchasing ledgers to prevent stockouts or over\-procurement.
* Coordinate daily logistics, freight haulers, and e\-way billing for on\-time dispatches to formulation hubs in North, West, and East India.
* Assist the Managing Director in monitoring customer ledger aging, coordinating with client procurement desks to resolve dispatch disputes, and ensuring customer collection cycles remain strictly within the targeted 60–90 day window.



  




 3\. Business Development \& Sales Enablement
 * Handle inbound sales inquiries, coordinate commercial price quotations and track customer sampling for line trials.
* Actively manage the commercial follow\-up for export vendor qualifications (coordinating regulatory documentation, sample logistics, and questionnaire completion)
* Liaise with in\-country indenters, domestic sales reps, and customer procurement teams to resolve commercial, invoicing, or packaging grievances before they escalate.



  




 Candidate Profile \& Qualifications
 * **Education:** 
 Full\-time MBA (Operations, Supply Chain, or General Management) from a reputable institute. A prior Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or B.Pharm is a distinct advantage.
* **Experience:** 
 3 to 6 years of operational experience in a manufacturing plant environment, industrial B2B enterprise, supply chain role, or as an EA to a Promoter/CXO in an industrial setup.



  





**Core Competencies:** 



* **High Integrity \& Discretion:** 
 Able to maintain strict confidentiality and serve as a reliable, unbiased reporting source for the promoter.
* **Diplomatic Authority:** 
 Capable of auditing plant floor performance and asking tough questions without creating destructive friction with the experienced technical Plant Head.
* **Commercial \& Financial Acumen:** 
 Strong fluency in P\&L basics, working capital cycles, debtor aging, and spreadsheet\-based operational modeling.
* **Language Proficiency:** 
 Fluent in English and Bengali (essential for daily communication with the local shop\-floor team and local contractors); working Hindi proficiency preferred for interstate client handling.

title: Business Development Executive Loans
description:
**Company: FairFinance** 




**Department: Business Development** 




**Job Type: Full\-Time** 




**Location: Hybrid – Bidhannagar, Kolkata** 




**Experience: Freshers \& Experienced Candidates Welcome** 




**Probation Period: 3 Months** 




  





**Compensation** 




 During the first 3 months (Probation): ₹15,000–₹20,000 per month
 



 After successful completion of probation: ₹25,000–₹50,000 per month
 



 Post\-probation compensation will depend on performance, skills, experience, and role suitability.
 



 Performance\-based incentives may also be applicable.
 



 Important: ₹25,000–₹50,000 is the compensation range after successful completion of the 3\-month probation period and is not the probation\-period salary.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 FairFinance is looking for a Business Development Executive – Loans to join our Business Development team.
 



 We are open to freshers who have relevant knowledge, strong communication skills, and a genuine interest in sales, business development, loans, and financial services.
 



 Previous work experience is not mandatory. However, candidates should have a basic understanding of the role and demonstrate the ability and willingness to learn about loan products, financial solutions, customer handling, and business development.
 



 Candidates with prior experience in sales, business development, banking, loans, NBFCs, fintech, customer relationship management, or financial services are also welcome to apply.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Understand customer requirements and assist customers with suitable loan and financial solutions.
 



 Communicate professionally with potential and existing customers.
 



 Build and maintain strong customer relationships.
 



 Follow up with leads and prospective customers throughout the sales process.
 



 Understand customer requirements and identify suitable business opportunities.
 



 Explain relevant loan/financial products and processes to customers.
 



 Coordinate with internal teams to support customer requirements and loan\-related processes.
 



 Maintain accurate records of leads, customer interactions, and follow\-ups.
 



 Work towards assigned business development and sales targets.
 



 Maintain regular follow\-ups to improve customer conversion and relationship management.
 



 Stay updated about relevant loan products, financial services, and market developments.
 



  





**Requirements** 




 Freshers are welcome to apply.
 



 Bachelor's degree in any discipline or currently pursuing graduation.
 



 Basic understanding of sales, business development, loans, banking, finance, or financial products.
 



 Strong verbal and written communication skills.
 



 Confident and professional approach when interacting with customers.
 



 Good relationship\-building and interpersonal skills.
 



 Comfortable with customer follow\-ups and target\-oriented work.
 



 Willingness to learn about loan products and financial services.
 



 Good problem\-solving and customer\-handling abilities.
 



 Ability to work independently as well as with a team.
 



 Prior internship, project, certification, or practical exposure in sales/finance/business development will be an advantage but is not mandatory.
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 Hybrid work opportunity in Bidhannagar, Kolkata
 



 ₹15,000–₹20,000/month during the 3\-month probation period
 



 ₹25,000–₹50,000/month after successful completion of probation, based on performance and suitability
 



 Performance\-based incentives
 



 Practical exposure to the financial services and loan industry
 



 Opportunity to develop sales and business development skills
 



 Customer relationship and financial\-product exposure
 



 Performance\-based career growth opportunities
 



  





**Who Should Apply?** 




 This role is particularly suitable for candidates who are freshers but have knowledge and interest in sales, business development, finance, loans, or customer relationships.
 



 You don't need years of experience to apply — but you should be comfortable speaking with customers, learning financial products, handling follow\-ups, and working towards business targets.
 



 Apply with your updated resume and relevant experience/projects, if applicable.
 


* **FairFinance — Building practical opportunities in financial services and business growth.**

title: App Sales Executive
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a
 
 App Sales Executive
 
 to lead and manage our network of sales partners who promote and sell the 123Greetings Pro Subscription to agencies and businesses. This is a hands\-on sales leadership role. You will guide, support, and motivate our sales partners as they work through the agency lists we assign, reach out to leads and make sales calls yourself, lead the onboarding calls with agency clients, help partners close more deals, and step in personally on high\-value or complex negotiations. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator and skilled negotiator, confident at closing, and knows how to get the best out of a sales team.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Sales Partner Team Leadership** 




 ●       Manage, guide, and support the company's network of sales partners.
 



 ●       Set clear activity and conversion goals for each partner and hold them accountable.
 



 ●       Coach and mentor partners on outreach, pitching, objection handling, and closing.
 



 ●       Guide partners as they onboard the agencies from the lead lists assigned to them.
 



 ●       Keep the team motivated and engaged across the partner network.
 



 ●       Run regular check\-ins, performance reviews, and training sessions.
 



  





**Communication \& Negotiation** 




 ●       Act as the main point of contact between the company and its sales partners.
 



 ●       Communicate product updates, pricing, offers, and sales guidance clearly to partners.
 



 ●       Lead or support negotiations on higher\-value and complex deals.
 



 ●       Handle escalations, objections, and non\-standard requests from prospects.
 



  





**Deal Closing \& Sales Execution** 




 ●       Reach out to leads and make sales calls directly, working the assigned agency lists alongside the partner team.
 



 ●       Actively support partners across the sales process, stepping in wherever needed to move deals forward.
 



 ●       Step in directly to help close key deals and convert priority agencies into paying customers.
 



 ●       Lead the onboarding calls with agencies as they are brought onto the Pro Subscription.
 



 ●       Review and strengthen partners' pitches and follow\-up to improve close rates.
 



 ●       Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing agency clients.
 



 ●       Keep the pipeline moving from first contact through to a signed subscription.
 



  





**Sales Process \& Enablement** 




 ●       Own the day\-to\-day sales process: lead assignment, follow\-up cadence, and conversion tracking.
 



 ●       Provide partners with sales scripts, materials, and best practices, and keep them up to date.
 



 ●       Identify what is working and roll out successful approaches across the whole network.
 



 ●       Ensure all outreach is professional, ethical, and in line with company guidelines.
 



  





**Performance Tracking \& Reporting** 




 ●       Track partner activity and conversions and review performance against targets.
 



 ●       Share regular sales updates and recommendations with leadership.
 



 ●       Spot underperformance early and put clear improvement plans in place.
 



  





**Requirements** 




 ●       1\-3 years in sales, with at least a year managing or leading a sales team.
 



 ●       Proven track record of closing deals and consistently hitting sales targets.
 



 ●       Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
 



 ●       Experience coaching, developing, and motivating salespeople or partners.
 



 ●       Comfortable leading from the front and closing deals personally.
 



 ●       Confident at building relationships with clients and partners.
 



 ●       Organised, with strong follow\-up and pipeline management habits.
 



 ●       Experience in B2B or subscription sales is a strong plus.

description:
**Sales Executive** 




  





**Location:** 
 Mumbai, New Delhi, and Kolkata, India

 2\-4 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Ultrafresh is a leading modular kitchen and home interior brand transforming houses into stylish, functional homes. Powered by the TTK Prestige Group, the company is headquartered in Mumbai, with regional offices in Delhi, Bengaluru, and Kolkata and more than 200 studios across India. Ultrafresh serves customers through kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliances, combining design\-led thinking with practical home solutions. Its advanced manufacturing capabilities and focus on innovation support consistent product quality and scalable customer delivery. The business blends craftsmanship and technology to create spaces that reflect each customer’s personality, while its studio network enables local engagement and consultation. As one of India’s fastest\-growing home lifestyle brands, Ultrafresh is expanding its reach by connecting customers with solutions tailored to their requirements, budgets, and living spaces. The company’s sales teams play a direct role in converting customer needs into satisfying, commercially successful home interior outcomes.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Sales Executive, you will own customer acquisition and revenue development across your assigned local market. You will generate demand through cold calling, networking, referrals, and relationships with customers, architects, interior designers, builders, and relevant businesses. Through face\-to\-face consultations, you will understand requirements, present suitable modular kitchen and home interior solutions, and convert qualified opportunities into sales. You will manage the sales pipeline, maintain accurate interaction records, negotiate pricing and terms, and prioritize opportunities that improve conversion and commercial outcomes. Success means building a reliable local customer base, strengthening relationships through responsive solution selling, and consistently achieving assigned sales targets. This is an onsite, field\-oriented role requiring regular travel, customer meetings, independent execution, and ownership of the complete sales process.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Generate qualified local leads through cold calling, networking, referrals, and relationship\-led outreach, expanding the opportunity base and improving the consistency of customer acquisition.
* Identify prospective customers, businesses, architects, interior designers, and builders whose requirements align with Ultrafresh’s modular home solutions and commercial growth priorities.
* Conduct face\-to\-face meetings, diagnose customer requirements, and present relevant kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliance solutions that improve fit, confidence, and conversion.
* Build trusted customer relationships through timely follow\-up and responsive engagement, protecting satisfaction while increasing referrals, repeat opportunities, and successful project progression.
* Own the sales pipeline by tracking opportunity stages, prioritizing high\-potential prospects, and maintaining accurate customer interaction records for disciplined follow\-through.
* Analyse customer needs and recommend effective solutions, balancing functional requirements, design expectations, pricing considerations, and commercial feasibility during the sales process.
* Negotiate pricing and terms within approved parameters, protecting customer value and business margins while moving qualified opportunities toward closure.
* Deliver assigned sales targets and objectives by managing daily field activity, conversion priorities, and pipeline coverage across the local base location.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to customer conversations, enabling clear recommendations, credible value articulation, and commercially sound closures.
* Demonstrate independence and teamwork in a field\-sales environment, taking ownership of local execution while coordinating effectively with internal colleagues and customer stakeholders.
* Communicate fluently in English and Hindi, with proficiency in at least one regional language, to build trust and conduct effective consultations across the assigned market.
* Apply structured pipeline management and accurate customer\-record discipline to prioritize opportunities, maintain visibility, and improve follow\-up quality throughout the sales cycle.
* Use customer\-need analysis and consultative selling to connect individual requirements with suitable modular products, supporting stronger conversion and customer satisfaction.
* Own a two\-wheeler and be prepared for regular field travel, customer meetings, networking, and face\-to\-face business development within the local market.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience selling modular kitchens, home interiors, or other modular products can shorten the learning curve and strengthen solution credibility with customers.
* Existing relationships with architects, interior designers, builders, or local business networks can accelerate qualified lead generation and improve market access.
* A proven record of meeting sales targets in the local base location demonstrates the commercial ownership needed to succeed in this role.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* You bring at least two years of direct, field, or B2C sales experience, with evidence that you can build a local pipeline and convert opportunities into measurable revenue.
* You communicate confidently in English and Hindi and can engage customers in at least one regional language, adapting your presentation to different needs, backgrounds, and decision\-making styles.
* You are comfortable working independently in the field while contributing to a team environment, taking responsibility for prospecting, meetings, follow\-ups, records, negotiations, and target delivery.
* You listen carefully to customer requirements and translate them into practical product recommendations, helping prospects understand the value of modular kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliances.
* You bring disciplined pipeline habits, accurate record keeping, and consistent follow\-through so every qualified opportunity receives the right attention at the right stage.
* You own a two\-wheeler and are willing to travel locally for customer meetings, networking, referrals, and relationship development.
* Familiarity with modular or concept\-based product selling, plus an existing network among architects, interior designers, or builders, will help you create momentum faster.
* Most importantly, you are commercially driven, relationship\-oriented, and motivated by achieving clear sales objectives while ensuring customers receive solutions that fit their practical and lifestyle requirements.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Join a fast\-growing home lifestyle brand with more than 200 studios across India, giving you access to a broad market and meaningful local sales opportunities.
* Sell a differentiated portfolio spanning modular kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliances, allowing you to solve complete home improvement needs rather than isolated product requirements.
* Work with the backing of the TTK Prestige Group while combining craftsmanship, technology, and innovation to create spaces that reflect each customer’s personality.
* Build a career in consultative field sales where disciplined execution, customer relationships, and measurable commercial outcomes directly shape business growth.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A role with direct ownership of local market development, customer acquisition, pipeline quality, negotiations, and sales\-target achievement.
* Exposure to a growing home interiors business with a broad product portfolio, studio network, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and opportunities to build valuable market relationships.
* A customer\-facing environment where strong performance can be demonstrated through qualified lead generation, conversion, relationship quality, and consistent commercial delivery.
